_comment: T-332 Hollowed Crypt boss 2 — Vharis, Voice of the Drowned Choir (interrupt/positioning teaching). Instance-scoped at the flooded_crypt anchor. Reuses the T-341 restless-shade mesh via render_kind; mob_id 'mob_crypt_vharis' is the unique kill-credit / T-333 loot alias. Mechanic beyond enrage: a channeled room-wide DIRGE (CombatState.CHANNELING + cast_start/cast_end plumbing, T-017) that pulses AoE damage to every player in the flooded crypt each tick; the party CANCELS it by dealing dirge_interrupt_damage to Vharis during the channel window. Uninterrupted it will wipe the room, so the interrupt is the fight. Enrage inert.
name: Vharis, Voice of the Drowned Choir
